tools.name: evaluate_domain
tools.description: Score exactly one domain 0-100 across structure, phonetics, brand, meaning, and market, with a best-effort RDAP availability hint. The score is a brand-quality read, not a price appraisal or a legal opinion. For several names in one call use evaluate_domains instead.

tools.name: evaluate_domains
tools.description: Batch-score up to 10 domains in one call and get per-domain evaluations plus an aggregate summary (top scorer, mean score). Malformed entries come back as per-item errors. For a single name use evaluate_domain. Costs one quota unit per evaluated domain.

tools.name: compare_domains
tools.description: Score 2-10 candidate domains and rank them: winner, score margin, and each name's strongest and weakest scoring group. Use when choosing between name options.

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Generate candidate names from keywords, keep the ones RDAP reports as available, and score up to 8 of them. Use for brainstorming alternatives or when a name is taken.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Best-effort RDAP registration check for one domain: available, taken (with registration date when the registry publishes it), or unknown. Free — requires a credential but costs no quota.
